value.rationale: For a published map explicitly intended to create chaotic behavior, global confinement versus unbounded motion is a structurally motivated distinction not measured by Lyapunov exponents. At the neutral boundary the simplest noninteger Markov beta factor has an exactly nonuniform transport drift and a closed asymptotic diffusion coefficient, along with exact finite-time covariances. These are natural global and statistical invariants, not arbitrary parameter slices: neutrality forces the beta semiconjugacy, and the golden beta is the first noninteger finite-Markov benchmark. Practical meaning is in transport calibration, not claimed encryption safety.
